g.text: Final turn after a forced path | Three fits per architecture | 500 fixed updates per fit

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6878

g.text: Dots: all three final fits. Horizontal marks: fit means. Only intact state is plotted; both reset conditions are also validated.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5c6878

g.text: Conditional CE renormalizes saved probabilities to left/right. Zero marks the equal-probability baseline. The lower axis shows millionths of a nat.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #364354

g.text: A 75% point is three of four contexts, with ties or tiny turn-probability margins. It does not establish a robust solution.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #364354

g.text: Same four selected seeds at all path lengths. Supervised diagnostic only: no gameplay, RL, unseen-map evaluation, or novelty claim.
